name: Key Format Converter
description: Convert keys between PKCS#1 / PKCS#8 / SPKI / DER / PEM and report the detected algorithm and format.

examples.label: Convert an SPKI public key to PKCS#8 (format constraint)
Convert an SPKI public key to DER

hints.format: A private key cannot become SPKI (a public key format), and a public key cannot become PKCS#1 / PKCS#8; such combinations are rejected explicitly.

faq.q: Does converting an encrypted private key decrypt it?
faq.a: No. An encrypted private key stays encrypted after conversion and still needs the passphrase to be read.

faq.q: What is the difference between DER and PEM?
faq.a: PEM is DER wrapped in a Base64 text envelope; choosing der returns the DER bytes in Base64.

faq.q: Why does converting a private key to SPKI fail?
faq.a: SPKI carries public keys only, so the conversion would silently drop the private material; it is rejected instead.
